name: The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas
positioning: Luxury hotel on McKinney Avenue in Uptown Dallas, with Fearing's Restaurant and a Club Lounge
best_for: Travelers who want an Uptown Dallas base with the McKinney Avenue trolley at the door
Diners drawn to Fearing's Restaurant and live music at Rattlesnake Bar

facts.text: The hotel is on McKinney Avenue in Uptown Dallas.
Fearing's Restaurant, led by celebrity chef Dean Fearing, offers a fine dining take on Southern cuisine.
Rattlesnake Bar has live music every Friday and Saturday, with curated cocktails and bar bites.
Fearing's Restaurant was named MICHELIN Recommended in 2025.
Guest rooms and suites have Frette linens.
Guest bathrooms are marble with Diptyque bath amenities.
The Deluxe Suite blends modern luxury with Art Deco touches and brass details.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
The spa has a sauna, steam room, cold plunge and whirlpool reserved for spa guests.
Children are welcome in the Club Lounge, where they can enjoy family games and freshly baked cookies.

highlights.text: Every night at 6 PM in the lobby, a live cellist plays and guests can have a signature toast with tequila created exclusively for Fearing's Restaurant.
The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas received the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star designation for the sixth consecutive year, announced in February 2026.
Fearing's has seven seating options, including a live-action kitchen, the mahogany-walled Rattlesnake Bar and an alfresco patio.
The vintage McKinney Avenue trolley stops in front of the hotel and carries visitors to shopping, restaurants and attractions in Uptown Dallas.

considerations.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded Club booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give complimentary access.
The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Dallas Love Field, the closest airport.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack resort-style outdoor spaces.
